digest.component_or_area: outbound comment differ / rich text codec
propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the outbound comment differ's two body-equality keys are produced by different decode compositions: the Jira side uses adf_to_text (no escaping) while the local side uses markdown round-trip (escapes markdown-active characters and rewrites autolinks).
An in-limit markdown comment with markdown-active characters never matches its own landed body because the local key carries escaped characters while the landed key does not.

The send path encodes a decorated body, and the HTML comment decoration causes markdown_to_adf to degrade the whole document to plain text, producing a landed wire that differs from the local round-trip of the undecorated body.
The truncation notice asymmetry mirrors the body asymmetry: local key carries \[truncated by reconciler\] while landed body carries [truncated by reconciler].
Fix requires deriving the local dedup key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used on the Jira side.

The asymmetry was introduced by commit 27b868ba55 which simultaneously moved the send path onto codec ADF encoding and flipped the local key to route through flag-governed normalize_outbound while leaving the Jira-side decode unchanged.
